hypothesis: Avoid constructing empty JsonNode shells for recursively discarded AST fields by specializing retained/discarded payload types while sharing the full grammar and validation
decision: REJECTED_AND_REVERTED: representative-TU improvement did not translate into an observed full-manifest audit benefit; retain regression tests, not additional production parser complexity
control: Frozen parser source read from base_commit and linked with the same current core scanner/manifest. Its git blob matched committed source exactly. Sequential two-worker full scans; no simultaneous build/test workload or source edits during timing

representative_translation_unit.scope: Fresh Clang compile, stream parse, actual visitor and macro preprocessing; not parser-only time. OS caches uncontrolled

full_manifest.limits: One sequential pair. Approximately 0.8 percent slower in this sample; not proof of a significant regression, but no measured full-workload gain to justify adopting the experiment

retained_test: A 10,000-element discarded array must still contribute every JSON value to accounting, match the independently stripped generic-parser result, and reject an unrepresentable numeric value hidden in the discarded payload. Tested in memory and streaming modes
next_direction: Do not repeat this parser specialization. Audit reuse needs explicit compiler/configuration/transitive-input invalidation and corruption/concurrent-mutation handling before adoption; no persistent cache or audit bypass was added. Placement-search and hardware-quality work remain open
unchanged: Gate thresholds and complete live runtime accounting
